name: Sister x Sister ~Lovevery Sisters~
source:
Kazuhisa is in love with Aika, who is beautiful and smart. Every male student loves Aika, but no one ever makes it. One day, he tells Aika that he loves her.... No, he doesn't make it, either.... When he feels down, Suzune, his classroom teacher, cheers him up.... They, however, gradually fall in love with each other and....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
和久爱上了美丽又聪明的爱香。每个男学生都喜欢爱香，但没有人能做到。有一天，他告诉爱香他爱她……不，他也没有做到……当他情绪低落时，他的班主任铃音给他打气……然而，他们逐渐爱上了彼此……

[来自工口游戏商店]
